resources.string: Battery level in big digits. Uses almost no power.
Long-press the home screen, tap Widgets, and find Battery Widget.

• The widget shows the battery level in percent, in big digits. It is the size of one app icon. You can resize it; the digits grow with it.

• White = on battery. Green = charger connected. Red = 15% or less.

• Tap the widget to refresh it now.

• To save power, the widget never wakes the phone. It refreshes every 15 minutes while the phone is awake (every 2 minutes on the charger). If a refresh came due while the phone was asleep, it runs as soon as the phone wakes up.

• After you connect or remove the charger, the color changes at the next refresh. Tap the widget to see it at once.

• It also refreshes when you leave this screen.
